about: `abandon` with no open run exits 1. Then a research run starts, and `abandon` on it, with no recover tried, exits 1 with "Run /script-asst:run recover first." The run stays open as it was, with no `recover_tried`, and no note changes.
spec: spec-run-manager.md 04 item 18 (abandon needs an open run with recover_tried)
readings: The refusal with no open run has no words in the spec, so only its exit code is checked.
